stemMd: A point has coordinates (4, −2, 7). In an orthographic projection onto the horizontal xy-plane, which coordinates remain?
explanationMd: Projection perpendicular to the horizontal plane removes the z-coordinate. The horizontal position is unchanged, so the image is (4, −2). This distinguishes plan position from elevation.

distractorRationale.e: This retains height rather than the y-coordinate.
distractorRationale.c: This is a projection onto the yz-plane.
distractorRationale.d: Projection removes height, not the y-coordinate.
distractorRationale.a: The first coordinate is x, not height.
